en: Color postcard showing a stone historic inn with arched ground floor, wooden balcony and a steep hip roof, set among lawns and birch trees, with modern apartment blocks in the background. The reverse is a Romanian postcard form with a 40 BANI Poșta Română stamp and a Bucharest 1969 postmark, a handwritten Romanian message, and printed caption indicating Suceava – Hanul Domnesc.
